subpart: Subpart E — Personal Protective and Life Saving Equipment

sections.title: PPE required
sections.req: Protective equipment must be provided, used, and maintained wherever hazards capable of causing injury are present.

sections.title: Head protection
sections.req: Hard hats required in areas where there is a possible danger of head injury from impact or falling objects.

sections.title: Eye and face protection
sections.req: Eye and face protection required where machines or operations present a hazard of flying particles, dust, or radiant energy.

subpart: Subpart C — General Safety and Health Provisions

sections.title: Safety program
sections.req: Employer must initiate and maintain a program that provides for frequent inspections of jobsites and equipment.

sections.title: Hazard recognition training
sections.req: Employees must be instructed to recognize and avoid unsafe conditions relevant to their specific work assignment.

sections.title: Grounding
sections.req: Non-current-carrying metal parts of equipment must be effectively grounded.

sections.title: Enclosure openings
sections.req: Unused openings in cabinets, boxes, and fittings must be effectively closed.

sections.title: Worn or frayed cords
sections.req: Worn or frayed electric cords or cables may not be used.

sections.title: Fall protection on scaffolds
sections.req: Each employee on a scaffold more than 10 feet above a lower level must be protected by a guardrail or personal fall arrest system.

sections.title: Scaffold access
sections.req: A ladder or equivalent safe access must be provided when the scaffold platform is more than 2 feet above or below a point of access.

sections.title: Scaffold training
sections.req: Each employee who performs work on a scaffold must be trained by a qualified person on scaffold hazards and controls.

sections.title: Unprotected sides and edges
sections.req: Fall protection required for employees on a walking/working surface with an unprotected side or edge 6 feet or more above a lower level.

sections.title: Personal fall arrest systems
sections.req: Fall arrest systems, when used, must limit maximum arresting force and be rigged so an employee cannot free fall more than 6 feet.

sections.title: Fall protection training
sections.req: Employer must provide a training program for each employee exposed to fall hazards, covering recognition and control of those hazards.

sections.title: Means of egress
sections.req: A stairway, ladder, ramp, or other safe means of egress required in trench excavations 4 feet or more in depth, within 25 feet of workers.

sections.title: Daily inspection
sections.req: A competent person must inspect excavations daily, before work begins, for evidence of hazardous conditions.

sections.title: Cave-in protection
sections.req: Employees in an excavation must be protected from cave-ins by an adequate protective system.
